status: prospective; no competition model trained for this round
reason: Test six deterministic numeric BPE keys in the existing GLM before spending GPU time on another neural architecture. The tokenizer supplies categories, not pretrained GPT-2 predictions.
idea_sources: Shallow-Tree Stack v31, locally inspected source lines 2402-2473
implementation_source: Independent implementation using the official OpenAI tiktoken API. No third-party code, merge tables, arrays or fitted models copied for this round.
hypothesis_limit: GPT-2-style generator artifacts are a hypothesis. This experiment neither proves the generator mechanism nor assumes third-party AUC gains will reproduce.
validation: Exploratory full-data StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=42). No independent holdout remains. Learned target maps are cross-fitted only within each outer training fold. No outer-validation early stopping is used by this GLM.

features.canonicalization: cents=np.rint(float64_USD*100); integer=cents//100; tokenize one ASCII space followed by str(integer). NumPy halfway ties round to even. This matches value_digits rounding and handles integer carry.
features.values: First and second token IDs as categorical strings; -1 if the second is absent; third key is second_id:cents_mod_100.
features.tail_policy: The fixed six-key hypothesis discards third and later integer tokens. In the audited training data this affects 6 amount rows and 12363 balance rows.
features.invalid_inputs: Reject negative, nonnumeric, boolean, non-finite and float64 cent-range overflow values.
features.unknown_categories: The existing fold-local TargetEncoder uses the outer-training prior for unseen keys. Token IDs do not imply numeric ordering.

tokenizer.offline_use: Initialize the hash-verified tokenizer cache once; reuse TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR offline. No paid API or neural model weights are used.

cost: One sequential CPU GLM run, four threads, five outer fits. Six extra target-encoded columns; no GPU training, model grid, new seed, pair features or weight sweep.
training_gate: Independent review must pass; root must test and freeze source before explicitly authorizing competition training.
submission_rule: Evaluate only this predefined probability mixture. Eligible only if pooled OOF gain over baseline exceeds 0.0001 and at least four of five folds improve. No leaderboard-driven changes. If it fails, record the null and do not submit. At most one submission, by root.
